{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent lag/undershoot bias throughout the 30-day horizon",
    "Sentiment signals have minimal explanatory power - zero sentiment often coincides with positive price movements and negative sentiment sometimes aligns with price advances",
    "Price mean-reversion is weak in the forecasts; model continues trending while prices exhibit more pronounced volatility and reversal patterns",
    "Forecast accuracy degrades rapidly as the horizon extends, with the largest errors emerging in the latter 50% of the 30-day forecast period",
    "Model maintains overly smooth trajectories that cannot capture the price volatility and inflection points in true outcomes",
    "When prices are in a declining phase, model forecasts decline too slowly, showing lag in recognizing momentum",
    "Sentiment alignment is inverse at times - periods of highest forecast confidence (most positive sentiment) frequently precede the largest actual price corrections"
] }
